cards.name: Ad Hoc Support
cards.skill: Draw 1 Skill card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: Who wants pizza???
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 5 points to transfer the effect to the player with lowest reputation.

cards.name: CI/CD Improvements
cards.skill:
When completed, add one Progress token to each of your Projects. 
If any Project finishes this way, lose one Favor. Then draw one card.
cards.flavorText: Life is what happens between deployments.
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 5 points to transfer the effect to the player with lowest reputation.

cards.name: Internal Project Budgety
cards.skill: Internal platform work: no reputation, but completing it restores +15 team health.

cards.name: Internal Project Finder
cards.skill: Internal platform work: no reputation, but completing it restores +15 team health.
cards.flavorText: Looking good!

cards.name: Internal Project Kiwi
cards.skill: Internal platform work: no reputation, but completing it restores +15 team health.
cards.flavorText: Majestic Digital Bird.

cards.name: Performance Optimization
cards.skill: Choose one of your Projects and add 2 Progress tokens to it.
cards.flavorText: So this was also happening in the other project...
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 5 points to transfer the effect to the player with lowest reputation.

cards.name: Pipeline Migration
cards.skill: Draw  1 Skill card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: Why we cannot go back to Make?
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 5 points to transfer the effect to the player with lowest reputation.

cards.name: Platform Launch
cards.skill: When completed, choose one of your Projects and add two Progress tokens to it.
cards.flavorText: So this was also happening in the other project...

cards.name: Redemption
cards.skill: The player with the lowest Reputation may play this card for free. They gain one team member from the Starter deck. When completed, draw one card.
cards.flavorText: Management's redemption. A last chance, this fall.
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 5 points to transfer the effect to the player with lowest reputation.

cards.name: Security Vulnerability
cards.skill: Draw 2 cards, then discard 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: I'm collecting CVEs
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 5 points to transfer the effect to the player with lowest reputation.

cards.name: Tech Upgrades
cards.skill: When completed, pick one Project from the discard pile and add it to your hand. Then draw one card.
cards.flavorText: We are changing protection for bugs.
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 5 points to transfer the effect to the player with lowest reputation.

cards.name: App Modernization
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: We need a new login and neon lights.

cards.name: Architecture Modernization
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: Let's try the new service until STG and then decide if it's worth it!

cards.name: CI/CD Migration
cards.skill: Draw 2 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: Who would it thought that Jenkins is popular  again in 2028?

cards.name: Disaster Recovery Implementation
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: DR all the way!

cards.name: Innovation
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: Also known as useful magic tricks.

cards.name: Internal Tools
cards.skill: Draw 2 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: You know, we really need this site.

cards.name: Library Creation
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: Who would it thought that Jenkins is popular  again in 2028?

cards.name: Lift-and-Shift
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: Two lies.

cards.name: On-Prem Migration
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card from the top of the For Hire deck.
cards.flavorText: By time we are done, there will be another one.

cards.name: 1:1 Meetings
cards.skill: Choose: hold 1:1s (skip your play phase, all teammates gain +1 progress) or skip them (+2 penalty to all projects next quarter).
cards.flavorText: So... how are things going? No, really.

cards.name: Angry Client
cards.skill:
Choose:
- Drop/Discard 2 Soft Skill cards
- Lose two progress from a project.

You may choose to do both
cards.flavorText: Well, this time he screamed slightly less. Progress?
cards.chanceSkill: The Active Player can transfer this event to the Lowest scoring player and resolve it.

cards.name: Attrition
cards.skill:
Choose one of the following effects:
- If one of your projects has 2 or fewer People assigned, fire the highest-value member from it.
- If one of your projects has more than  People assigned, fire the lowest-value member from it.
cards.flavorText: Push to Prod they said, it will be fun, they said.

cards.name: Changing Requirements
cards.skill:
Increase the Progress Requirement by X of your project with more Talent assigned to it.

X will equal to the combination of discarded cards:
- 10: 3 Hard Skill cards.
- 7: 3 Soft Skill cards.
- 0: Power Skill + any other Skill Card.

If you refuse or are unable to pay, you lose 20 reputation points.
cards.flavorText: If you don't know your next move, they won't be able to predict it either.

cards.name: Company Priorities
cards.skill:
Drop/Discard one Project or lose 10 reputation.
You may choose to do both.
cards.flavorText: You don't have to like our decision, just obey.

cards.name: Executive Review
cards.skill: VP demands a status update. If your total project progress is over 50%, gain +3 rep. Under 50%, lose 3 rep.
cards.flavorText: The VP has 'a few questions' about your roadmap.

cards.name: Failed Release
cards.skill:
Choose your project with the Highest number of assigned People.
 It cannot progress this quarter.
cards.flavorText: Push to Prod they said, it will be fun, they said.

cards.name: Hiring
cards.skill:
Pay 5.
Draw a Talent card and assign it immediately..
cards.flavorText: After six interviews and three approvals, we hired someone who starts in two quarters.
cards.chanceSkill: The Active Player can transfer this event to the Highest scoring player and resolve it.

cards.name: Knowledge Silo
cards.skill: Your highest-value team member quits. Lose all progress on their assigned project. Negate with a Documentation card in hand.
cards.flavorText: They were the only one who knew how that system worked.

cards.name: Meeting Overload
cards.skill: All your people produce 1 less progress this quarter (minimum 0).
cards.flavorText: Could this meeting have been an email? Yes. All of them.

cards.name: Meetings
cards.skill:
Drop/Discard a Project or discard one card from your hand.
You may choose to do both.
cards.flavorText: I need vacations to finally start making progress.

cards.name: Mentorship
cards.skill:
Unassign a Senior from a project until next quarter.
On your following turn, you may add the lowest-level People card from the For Hire deck to your hand..
cards.flavorText: Yes, crying is part of the work, congrats!

cards.name: Missing Story Points
cards.skill: Unassign one member  your projects until next quarter.
cards.flavorText: Seems like a 5 but since you didn't update it, it's a 1.
cards.chanceSkill: The Active Player can transfer this event to the Highest scoring player and resolve it.

cards.name: OKR Alignment
cards.skill: Reassign one of your active Highest Level team member to a project of Lowest Value priority.
cards.flavorText: The new priority replaced the last one. For now, at least.
cards.chanceSkill: The Active Player can transfer this event to the Highest scoring player and resolve it.

cards.name: Onboarding
cards.skill:
Associate this card with your last played Talent card. Unassign it until next quarter.
In the next quarter, you can purchase up to 2 cards from the For Hire deck in a single turn.
cards.flavorText: Just roll with it.
cards.chanceSkill: The Active Player can transfer this event to the Lowest scoring player and resolve it.

cards.name: Production Outage
cards.skill: All your talent cards are on incident response for 1 quarter. Your projects do not progress this quarter.
cards.flavorText: Page everyone. Cancel all meetings. We're in war room mode.

cards.name: Promotion Cycle
cards.skill: Choose one team member to promote: +2 progress on their project and gain 1 Favor. Or decline all promotions: each teammate gets +2 frustration (lose 2 rep next quarter).
cards.flavorText: HR says it's that time again. Budget says otherwise.

cards.name: RFP
cards.skill:
**Draw 2 cards**.
**Reveal both** to your opponents.
They **choose one** for you to keep. **Discard the other.**
cards.flavorText: We don't know what we want, but we need it by Monday.

cards.name: Skills Gap
cards.skill:
Choose one:
- Pay 2 points using Hard Skill cards.
- Pay 4 points using Soft Skill cards.
- Pay 0 by discarding a Power Skill + any other Skill Card.

If you refuse or are unable to pay, you lose 15 reputation points.
cards.flavorText: We're aiming for a deadline that was… last week. I trust you'll make it happen!

cards.name: Skip-Level Surprise
cards.skill: Your skip-level wants a private meeting. Discard 1 active project to gain +10 rep, or decline and lose 5 rep.
cards.flavorText: Hey, got a minute? Close the door.

cards.name: Team Conflict
cards.skill:
Choose one:
- Pay 4 points using Hard Skill cards.
- Pay 2 points using Soft Skill cards.
- Pay 0 by discarding a Power Skill + any other Skill Card.

If you refuse or are unable to pay, you lose 15 reputation points.
cards.flavorText: What is it now?

cards.name: Team Reorg
cards.skill:
The **active player must unassign all People** from their current projects.

Pay **10 reputation** to **nullify** this effect.
cards.flavorText: I know you are busy, but corporate wants to see everyone dancing.

cards.name: Uncertainty
cards.skill: Talent not currently assigned to a project cannot be assigned to any of your projects until next quarter.
cards.flavorText: Uncertainty leads to fear, and fear to low performance.

cards.name: AI Companion
cards.skill:
Can only be included to a project where a Senior Lv. 2, 3, or Tech Lead is present.
Max 1 per player, and this card doesn't add progress.

Projects that last less than 3 quarters where this card is included, are reduced by 1.
cards.flavorText: You have reached out the max amount number of tokens.

cards.name: Contractor
cards.skill:
When a project is completed with this card assigned to it, draw 1 card.

If this card is part of a project selected for the "Attrition" event, you can select this card instead.
cards.flavorText: Corporate Mercenaries.

cards.name: Manager (Starter)
cards.skill:
If you unassign this card for this quarter, you can reduce the cost of one Project Queue card by 2 for the rest of the quarter.

If this card is part of a project selected for the RFP event, you can negate it.

cards.name: Project Manager
cards.skill: Reveal the top Rush Quarter card. Pay 1 Favor to negate it.
cards.flavorText: Let's figure it out.

cards.name: Punished Senior
cards.skill:
Can be bought by 0 for the lowest scoring player from Q3 onwards.

If this card is part of a project selected for the Scope Creep event, you can negate it.
cards.flavorText: Let's blame us and move on.

cards.name: QA
cards.skill:
Draw 1 Skill card.

If this card is part of a project selected for the Failed Release event, you can negate it.
cards.flavorText: Could you please provide the steps to reproduce the issue?

cards.name: Semi Senior
cards.skill:
Draw 1 card.
This card won't add progress to a project, but it counts for the OpEx requirements.
cards.flavorText: Let's ask infra.

cards.name: Semi Senior Lv. 1 (Starter)
cards.skill:
Draw 1 Skill card.

If a project assigned to this card suffers quarter reduction, the effect will be reduced by 2.
cards.flavorText: Semi Simio

cards.name: Senior Developer
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card.
cards.flavorText: Let's blame infra.

cards.name: Senior Lv. 1
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card.
cards.flavorText: It is what it is.

cards.name: Senior Lv. 1 (Starter)
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project card.
cards.flavorText: I'm excited.

cards.name: Senior Lv. 1.5
cards.skill:
Draw 1 Bonus Project card.

If this card is part of a project selected for the Onboarding event, you can negate it.
cards.flavorText: I'm excited.

cards.name: Senior Lv. 3
cards.skill:
Draw 1 Skill card.

If this card is part of a project selected for the Changing Requirements event, you can negate it.
cards.flavorText: I've wrestled with alligators, I've tussled with a whale...

cards.name: Senior Lv. 4 Data
cards.skill: Draw 1 Skill card.
cards.flavorText: Let's blame Devs.

cards.name: Senior Lv. 4 The Architect
cards.skill: Once per project you may reduce the quarter requirements by 1.
cards.flavorText: Let's blame Security.

cards.name: Specialist
cards.skill:
Choose one:
- Draw 2 immediately
- Nullify a Rush Quarter card.
- Draw 1 bonus project after completing a project with this card.
cards.flavorText: P4G.

cards.name: Tech Lead
cards.skill:
This card adds two progress instead of one.

If this card is part of a project selected for the Skills Gap event, you can negate it.
cards.flavorText: It's always something, isn't?

cards.name: Good but not good enough
cards.skill:
The player will be **fired** unless they can pay **20 points** using played cards.
**Point Values:**
- **People**: 5 points each
- **Active Projects**: 5 points each
- **Favors**: 5 points each
- **Completed Projects**: Worth **half** their reward value (rounded up)
- **Earned Reputation Points**: 1 point per reputation
cards.flavorText: Bon mon ami, but not bon enough.

cards.name: It's not you, it's me
cards.skill:
The player will be **fired** unless they can pay **25 points** using played cards.
**Point Values:**
- **People**: 5 points each
- **Active Projects**: 5 points each
- **Favors**: 5 points each
- **Completed Projects**: Worth **half** their reward value (rounded up)
- **Earned Reputation Points**: 1 point per reputation
cards.flavorText: Maybe we should try other people.

cards.name: Overqualified
cards.skill:
The player will be **fired** unless they can pay **10 points** using played cards.
**Point Values:**
- **People**: 5 points each
- **Active Projects**: 5 points each
- **Favors**: 5 points each
- **Completed Projects**: Worth **half** their reward value (rounded up)
- **Earned Reputation Points**: 1 point per reputation
cards.flavorText: You are wasting yourself here...

cards.name: You deserve better
cards.skill:
The player will be **fired** unless they can pay **15 points** using played cards.
**Point Values:**
- **People**: 5 points each
- **Active Projects**: 5 points each
- **Favors**: 5 points each
- **Completed Projects**: Worth **half** their reward value (rounded up)
- **Earned Reputation Points**: 1 point per reputation

cards.name: Ambition Backfires
cards.skill: Every player with 2+ projects in play loses 3 reputation per project unless they discard 1 Favor.

cards.name: Board Review
cards.skill: The player with the lowest reputation must defend their performance. Lose an additional 5 rep. If tied, all tied players lose 3 rep.
cards.flavorText: The board wants to 'align on expectations.'

cards.name: Budget Cuts
cards.skill: All players must return 1 assigned person to the For Hire pool. Unless they pay 2 favor.

cards.name: Freeze
cards.skill: Next quarter, players won't be able to play any project.
cards.flavorText: Let it goooo, let it goooo~

cards.name: Invisible Work Tax
cards.skill: All active projects gain +1 quarter to their deadline. Toil, on-call, and support tickets slow everyone down.
cards.flavorText: Nobody sees the work that keeps the lights on.

cards.name: Legacy Strikes Back
cards.skill: Each player selects the project with more quarters remaining, they must complete it in one quarter.

cards.name: Missing Deadline
cards.skill:
During the next quarter, all projects will have -1 quarter to be completed.
Unless you have 3+ Favor.

cards.name: Reorg Roulette
cards.skill: Each player passes 1 random team member to the player on their left. All assignments reset.
cards.flavorText: Surprise! You now report to someone else.

cards.name: SOX Compliance
cards.skill:
Next quarter you can't play any projects.
You can avoid this by either:
- Unassign a "Manager" card during the next quarter.
- Pay 4 points in Hard Skill cards.
- Pay 2 Favor cards.

cards.name: Scope Creep
cards.skill: Bonus projects won't be gained this quarter.

cards.name: Technical Debt
cards.skill: Each player adds 1 debt token per rushed project (completed ahead of deadline). Each debt token reduces project progress by 1 next quarter.
cards.flavorText: We'll fix it later. Later never comes.

cards.name: Unrealistic Expectations
cards.skill: Completion time for any existent or new project, will be reduced by 1.

cards.name: Automated Testing
cards.skill: Prevent the next Event card that would affect you. Discard this card instead.
cards.flavorText: The build is green. Ship it.

cards.name: Code Review
cards.skill: Add 1 progress to a project. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavorText: LGTM. Just kidding, 47 comments.

cards.name: Cross-Team Dependency
cards.skill: Add 1 quarter to one project.
cards.flavorText: Perfect is the enemy of MVPs.

cards.name: Documentation
cards.skill: Add 1 progress to a project. This card also protects against Knowledge Silo events.
cards.flavorText: Future you will thank present you.

cards.name: Efficient Specialist
cards.skill: Add 2 Progress to a project.
cards.flavorText: GL HF

cards.name: Optimize Workflow
cards.skill: Draw 1 card for each active project that you control. Discard the same number after.

cards.name: Organization and Planning
cards.skill:
To play this card you cannot assign Talent to Projects during this quarter.
Discard up-to 3 cards from your hand, and draw the same number from the Skill Deck.
cards.flavorText: EZ WIN
cards.chanceSkill: Pay **3** and show who's the boss.

cards.name: Pair Programming
cards.skill: Choose 2 people on the same project. They produce 3 progress total this quarter instead of 2.
cards.flavorText: Two keyboards, one monitor, zero personal space.

cards.name: Production Release Preparation
cards.skill: Add 2 Progress to a project.
cards.flavorText: You only live once.
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 0, nullify it. The player that used this card loses the project.

cards.name: Refactoring Sprint
cards.skill: Remove 1 quarter from a project's deadline (minimum 1).
cards.flavorText: It's not gold-plating if it prevents fires.

cards.name: Skilled Execution
cards.skill: Add 1 Progress to a project.
cards.flavorText: Easy Peasy
cards.chanceSkill: Pay **3** to nullify the skill.

cards.name: Breakthrough
cards.skill:
Advance every project by VAR quarter.
If each player discards VAR card.

cards.name: Defensive Maneuver
cards.skill: One-time use per game. Pay 10 reputation to negate any card targeting you.
cards.flavorText: I have protection...
cards.chanceSkill:
Pay 10 to nullify.

Active Player can draw 1 Skill card.

cards.name: Domain Collision
cards.skill: Exchange one of your projects with an opponent's project that has the same or fewer members. Both players lose 5 reputation. If either project completes this quarter, +10 bonus.
cards.flavorText: Mine, mine, mine!!!
cards.chanceSkill: If nullified, the target opponent may steal 1 Favor from you.

cards.name: Fast Learner
cards.skill: Add to your hand 1 card from the Skill discard pile.
cards.flavorText: Whoops! We had a dependency, hopefully you can allocate someone!
cards.chanceSkill:
Pay **2** and the player that used this card will suffer the effects. **TWICE**.

Sadly, it was on your side!

cards.name: Foresight
cards.skill: Gain immunity to events for 2 quarters. Immunity breaks on Company Priorities or Team Reorg.

cards.name: Heroic Programming
cards.skill: Solo a 3-person project for 1 quarter (count as 3 people). That person cannot be assigned next quarter. Add 1 debt token.
cards.flavorText: I'll sleep when the sprint is over.

cards.name: OOO Time!
cards.skill: Skip 1 quarter of events. Your projects do not progress while OOO.
cards.chanceSkill:
Pay 10 to skill a project with less than two people.

I call dibs!

cards.name: Overreach
cards.skill: Pay 5 Reputation to draw 2.
cards.flavorText: Ban this pot.

cards.name: Owed Favors
cards.skill: Gain 3 Reputation Points per each favor you have from other players.
cards.flavorText: Do I really have to tell you what happened at the **Q3 FY22**?

cards.name: Reassign Resources
cards.skill: Move 1 unassigned team member from a player to another.
cards.flavorText: They could handle some extra assignations
cards.chanceSkill: If nullified, gain 1 Favor.

cards.name: Resume-Driven Development
cards.skill: Start a project with unproven tech: add 1 quarter to deadline and 1 debt token. If completed, +5 bonus rep.
cards.flavorText: Let's rewrite it in Rust. For the resume.

cards.name: Shared Problems
cards.skill: Add 1 quarter to all project.
cards.flavorText: We're all in this together, right?
cards.chanceSkill: If nullified, the player may assign 1 team member to a project.

cards.name: Shift The blame
cards.skill: Target player loses 10 reputation. Each use costs 5 more reputation.
cards.flavorText: Let's find a compromise...
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 4 to nullify this card.

cards.name: Ship It and Forget It
cards.skill: Complete any project immediately, skipping QA. 50% chance of Failed Release next quarter (lose the project reward).
cards.flavorText: What could possibly go wrong?

cards.name: Undermine Reputation
cards.skill: Target player loses 5 reputation. You gain 3 reputation.
cards.flavorText: That manager hasn't faced any drama this month, he is lacking off!!!
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 5 reputation to reverse the effect. The player who used the card suffers it instead.

cards.name: Wonderful Move
cards.skill:
You may move progress from 1 of your projects to another by paying 2 reputation points.
You cannot move progress if it will leave a project without progress tokens.
cards.flavorText: Maravillosa jugada!
cards.chanceSkill:
Pay 4 to nullify and apply the effect in your team

You know, that's a great idea!

cards.name: Brainstorming
cards.skill:
Choose 1 project. Progress it by 1 for each player who discards a Hard Skill card.
All who help gain 1 Bonus Favor.
cards.flavorText: Not so fast!
cards.chanceSkill: The player who nullifies this effect may draw 1 card.

cards.name: Charm People
cards.skill: Move 1 unassigned team member from one manager to another.
cards.flavorText: Have you see his projects? Ulala
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 4 reputation to nullify the effect. The opponent loses 5 reputation points.

cards.name: Compromise
cards.skill:
Pay 1 reputation to nullify the opponent's Skill card.

Discard 1 ca
cards.flavorText: We promise to not cause any more ruckus... for at least what's left of this year.

cards.name: Counter Argument
cards.skill:
Pay 3 reputation to nullify the opponent's Skill card.

Or discard a Hard Skill card.
cards.flavorText: I have a counter-argument...
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 2 reputation to cancel the effect. The player who used the card loses 1 reputation point.

cards.name: Fit Interviews
cards.skill:
Draw 2 People cards.
Choose 1 to keep and give the other to any player that can give you a favor. If none, then discard that card.
cards.flavorText: Trust me, it's bro science!
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 7 points, you become the target of that effect, and choose first.

cards.name: It's Show Time
cards.skill:
Spend up to 3 Favor. For each Favor spent, gain 1 of the following:
- Draw 1 card
- Add 1 quarter to a project's deadline
- Block an Event this turn
cards.flavorText: If you want to see some action.
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 3 favor to nullify.

cards.name: Lighten the Mood
cards.skill: Reduce reputation damage based from the number of team members that you have.
cards.flavorText: We can either laugh or cry, Imma do both.
cards.chanceSkill:
Lack of seriousness.
Pay 1 reputation and discard a Soft Skill, nullify the effect.

cards.name: Request Help
cards.skill: Choose an opponent from which you have favors from. They must give you one progress from any project.
cards.flavorText: I need your help with this project...
cards.chanceSkill: Pay **2**, reject the request.

cards.name: Soothing Response
cards.skill: Add 1 quarter to one project.
cards.flavorText: Shhh Sh sh shhh... we can push the deadline.

cards.name: Sprint Planning
cards.skill: Rearrange team members across your projects.
cards.flavorText: EZ WIN
cards.chanceSkill: Pay **3** and show who's the boss.

cards.name: Talk Over
cards.skill: Pay 5 reputation to nullify the opponent's Skill card.
cards.flavorText: Not so fast!
cards.chanceSkill: Pay 1 reputation to reject the request.

cards.name: Bonus Favor
cards.skill: Favor cards let you trade with or ask help from another player.
cards.flavorText: Only redeemable when you are in the company.

cards.name: It's my first day!
cards.skill:
Nullifies anything but the following card types: 
- Events
- Rush quarters (Q4+)
- Layoff.
cards.flavorText: Be nice!

cards.name: Backlog Cleaning
cards.skill: At the end of your next turn, you can draw 2 Skill cards.
cards.flavorText: From 1 to 8 Story points, your move!

cards.name: Data Recollection
cards.skill:
Draw 2 Skill cards.
If you are the first player completing a project with this card, draw 3 instead.
cards.flavorText: Fill this quiz in this random spreadsheet that you won't ever see again past this month.

cards.name: Documentation Update
cards.skill: Just once, an onboarding or Hiring card won't require to lose a member.
cards.flavorText: Last update was a few years ago.

cards.name: E. P. H. Q. A.
cards.skill: Draw 1 Bonus Project.
cards.flavorText: Last update was a few years ago.

cards.name: Report Automation
cards.skill: Draw 3 Skill cards and then discard 2 cards.
cards.flavorText: We need a summary of the executive summary.

cards.name: Security Tickets
cards.skill: Draw 1 card and get a discount of one point for any card of the Project Queue
cards.flavorText: Fill this quiz in this random spreadsheet that you won't ever see again past this month.

cards.name: First Turn
cards.skill:
- Draw 1 card from the Projects (Starter Cards Deck).
- Draw 1 card from the People (Starter Cards Deck).
- Draw 5 cards from the Main Deck.
- Play your cards.
- At the end of your turn, draw 2 cards from the Main Deck.

cards.name: Rules
cards.skill:
**Points**
- If no specific point type is listed as a cost, you may pay with any combination of available point types.

**Stores**
- At the end of the last player's turn in Q1, the Project Queue deck (Business Cards) becomes available for purchases.
- At the end of the last player's turn in Q2, the For Hire deck (Business Cards) becomes available for purchases.
- You can buy one card from each Business deck per turn, unless an effect states otherwise.

cards.name: Turn
cards.skill:
- Draw & resolve an Event. (Q2+)
- Play cards from hand or field.
- At the end of your turn, draw 1 card from the Main Deck.
- Once all players have finished their turn:
    - Progress the projects and resolve their abilities.
    - Draw & resolve a Rush Quarter. (Q2+)
    - Draw & resolve a Layoff. (FY1 Q1+)

cards.name: Big push
cards.skill: This budget only works for the active quarter; unspent funds expire at period end.

cards.name: Accountability
cards.skill: Take ownership of failures and drive a learning culture. Short-term reputation cost, long-term trust gain.

cards.name: Adaptability
cards.skill: Embrace organizational change and pivot quickly. Resistance wastes energy; adaptation wins.

cards.name: Culture Integration
cards.skill: Align team cultures after a merger. Focus on people first, tech second.

cards.name: Customer Communication
cards.skill: Communicate proactively with affected customers. Transparency reduces support volume and builds trust.

cards.name: Full Disclosure
cards.skill: Disclose issues transparently to all stakeholders. Builds lasting trust.

cards.name: Independence
cards.skill: Develop autonomous capability. Stop depending on others for basic needs.

cards.name: Knowledge Transfer
cards.skill: Transfer critical knowledge from key personnel to the broader team.

cards.name: Morale Boost
cards.skill: Restore team motivation during difficult times. Happy teams ship faster.

cards.name: Scope Negotiation
cards.skill: Push back on scope changes diplomatically. Protect delivery and team focus.

cards.name: Scope Reduction
cards.skill: Strategically reduce scope to meet constraints. Less is more.

cards.name: Self-Reliance
cards.skill: Build independent capability. Break the cycle of external dependency.

cards.name: Transparency
cards.skill: Share information openly. Builds trust and enables better decisions.

cards.name: Architectural Review
cards.skill: Evaluate system architecture for scalability. Identify bottlenecks before they break.

cards.name: Build In-House
cards.skill: Build custom solution to replace vendor dependency. Full control, higher cost.

cards.name: Build vs Buy
cards.skill: Analyze trade-offs between building in-house and purchasing external solutions.

cards.name: Control Implementation
cards.skill: Implement required security and compliance controls. Necessary foundation.

cards.name: Cross-Training
cards.skill: Train multiple team members on critical systems. Eliminate knowledge silos.

cards.name: Documentation Sprint
cards.skill: Focused effort to create essential documentation before it is too late.

cards.name: Feature Freeze
cards.skill: Pause new features to focus on quality and stability. Painful but effective.

cards.name: Gap Analysis
cards.skill: Identify gaps between current state and target. Know what matters most.

cards.name: Market Analysis
cards.skill: Research market landscape and competitive positioning before committing.

cards.name: Migration Plan
cards.skill: Detailed plan to migrate between platforms or vendors. Your escape route.

cards.name: Migration Strategy
cards.skill: Strategic approach to system migrations. Phase it, do not big-bang it.

cards.name: Patch Now
cards.skill: Apply critical security patches immediately. Accept downtime over breach risk.

cards.name: Post-Incident Review
cards.skill: Structured review after incidents to prevent recurrence. Blameless, focused.

cards.name: Post-Mortem
cards.skill: Run a structured post-mortem. Turn failures into prevention.

cards.name: Public Status Page
cards.skill: Provide real-time public status during incidents. Reduces panic.

cards.name: Refactoring Quarters
cards.skill: Dedicate time each quarter to reduce tech debt systematically.

cards.name: Risk Assessment
cards.skill: Evaluate risks and their potential impact before making commitments.

cards.name: Strangulation Pattern
cards.skill: Incrementally replace legacy systems in place. No big rewrites.

cards.name: Sunset Plan
cards.skill: Plan to retire and phase out a legacy product gracefully.

cards.name: Tech Debt
cards.skill: Address accumulated technical shortcuts that slow delivery.

cards.name: Technical Due Diligence
cards.skill: Evaluate technology assets and liabilities in an acquisition.

cards.name: Temporary Controls
cards.skill: Deploy short-term compensating security controls while permanent fix is built.

cards.name: War Room Protocol
cards.skill: Structured protocol for incident response. Bring focus to chaos.

cards.name: Build Capability
cards.skill: Invest in long-term skill and system building. Sustainable growth.

cards.name: All-In
cards.skill: Commit all resources to a single high-risk play. Win big or lose big.

cards.name: Comeback Play
cards.skill: Execute a dramatic recovery. Turn desperation into determination.

cards.name: Data-Driven Pitch
cards.skill: Use data to make the business case to executives. Metrics beat opinions.

cards.name: Dual Vendor Strategy
cards.skill: Abstract APIs to avoid single vendor lock-in. Options equal power.

cards.name: Executive Escalation
cards.skill: Escalate critical decisions to executive leadership with structured reasoning.

cards.name: Hail Mary
cards.skill: Last-resort, high-risk play. When safe options have already failed.

cards.name: Last Stand
cards.skill: Final all-out effort. Nothing held back. Make it count.

cards.name: MVP Strategy
cards.skill: Validate with a minimum viable product before full commitment.

cards.name: Risk It All
cards.skill: Maximum risk for maximum potential return. Calculated desperation.

cards.name: Stop the Line
cards.skill: Halt all work to fix critical systemic issues. The Toyota Way.

cards.name: Take the Hit
cards.skill: Accept short-term pain for long-term sustainability. Strategic sacrifice.

cards.name: Team Topology
cards.skill: Align team structure with system architecture. Conway Law as a tool.

cards.name: Audit Prep Team
cards.skill: Dedicated team for compliance preparation. Focus prevents fire drills.

cards.name: Bridge Team
cards.skill: Cross-functional team connecting two groups. Builds relationships across silos.

cards.name: Enablement Team
cards.skill: Internal team that unblocks and enables product teams at scale.

cards.name: Hire Full-Time
cards.skill: Convert a contractor to a permanent team member. Stability and commitment.

cards.name: Hiring Blitz
cards.skill: Rapid hiring spree to fill critical gaps quickly.

cards.name: Hiring Freeze
cards.skill: Pause all hiring to stabilize the organization and control burn.

cards.name: Incident Response
cards.skill: Coordinate a structured team response to a production incident.

cards.name: Platform Team
cards.skill: Create a dedicated internal platform team to reduce duplication.

cards.name: Recovery Team
cards.skill: Dedicated team for system recovery operations during outages.

cards.name: Resource Reallocation
cards.skill: Shift resources between projects strategically based on priorities.

cards.name: Retention Bonus
cards.skill: Financial incentive to retain critical talent during uncertain times.

cards.name: Tiger Team
cards.skill: Focused strike team dedicated to solving the hardest problems.

cards.name: Ask Again
cards.skill: Request help from colleagues one more time. Dependency deepens.

cards.name: Blame Shift
cards.skill: Redirect blame to another team. Quick fix, toxic long-term.

cards.name: Escrow Clause
cards.skill: Contractual protection against vendor failure or bankruptcy.

cards.name: Partnership
cards.skill: Partner with external organization to share risk and investment.

cards.name: Price Negotiation
cards.skill: Negotiate better terms with vendors. Leverage your position.

cards.name: Silence
cards.skill: Stay quiet and avoid accountability. No immediate cost, trust erodes.

cards.name: Executive Review
cards.skill: Present to executive leadership for strategic alignment and approval.

cards.name: All-nighter
cards.skill: Burn the midnight oil to ship a critical feature. Gain immediate progress but risk burnout.
cards.flavorText: Coffee is a food group, right?

cards.name: Architecture Review
cards.skill: Conduct a formal architecture review to validate tech decisions and reduce future tech debt.
cards.flavorText: Measure twice, cut once.

cards.name: Debug Session
cards.skill: Deep debugging session to resolve critical production issues. Provides clarity but takes time.
cards.flavorText: It works on my machine...

cards.name: Hotfix
cards.skill: Emergency patch to fix a critical bug. Immediate impact but potential for introducing new issues.
cards.flavorText: This will only take 5 minutes.

cards.name: Innovation Lab
cards.skill: Create dedicated time and space for experimentation and innovation. Long-term culture impact.
cards.flavorText: What if we tried...

cards.name: Metrics Review
cards.skill: Review and present key metrics to stakeholders. Builds trust through transparency.
cards.flavorText: The numbers don't lie.

cards.name: Platform Strategy
cards.skill: Define and implement a platform strategy that enables multiple products. High investment, high return.
cards.flavorText: Build once, leverage everywhere.

cards.name: Stakeholder Alignment
cards.skill: Facilitate discussion to align stakeholder expectations and priorities. Reduces future conflicts.
cards.flavorText: Everyone on the same page.

cards.name: Team Meeting
cards.skill: Regular sync to share context and build team cohesion. Prevents silos.
cards.flavorText: This could have been an email... or not.

cards.name: Tech Debt Paydown
cards.skill: Dedicate resources to address accumulated technical debt. Improves long-term velocity.
cards.flavorText: Fixing yesterday's shortcuts.

cards.name: Testing
cards.skill: Implement comprehensive testing strategy. Prevents future issues but requires upfront investment.
cards.flavorText: Tests are the documentation that never lies.
